notes: Booklet step numbering counts sub-assemblies: main steps 1-42, dome A sub-steps 43-46, main 43 = 47, dome B 48-51, main 44-47 = 52-55, centre dome sub-assembly 56-61, main 48 = 62, tower sub-steps 63-75, main 49-56 = 76-83.
The grid layout is approximate: the base is modelled as a 4-wide, 32-long strip with two plate layers, and the front black tiles are attached sideways to the 87609 plates (position null).

Fixes in this version: the Rialto arches p191/p192 now sit on the p75 plate (two cones moved onto the arches) so the left bridge joins the rest of the model; the headlight brick p136, the panel p142 and p135 no longer collide with the p115 technic brick; the four corner tiles no longer share cells (p5, p7, p4 each get their own 2x2 area).

The right end of the base cannot hold all the layer-2 tiles on the 4x32 strip I assumed. The fourth corner tile p6 therefore overhangs the end (x=32) with nothing clutched below. It is tied to the model by an edge-contact entry against p28, and the booklet does not show it hanging free.
p48 (brown 2x4) has an empty rests_on because no stud-bearing piece lies under it in my layout. Its connection comes from the pieces that rest on it (p52, p53).
Piece 4224792 in the inventory is the plate with tooth (lego-49668): four windows go into the technic bricks in step 54 and two onto the headlight bricks in step 55.

Parts built sideways or on a bar or open stud (front tiles, side-stud plates, windows, bars, column plates, clip tile, statuette) have null positions; their connections are in other_joins or rests_on.
